# First Principles UI

> Deterministic UI layout, perceptual contrast, typography, and mathematical verification. Each concept is a short explainer with an interactive demo by First Principles UI.

Every concept is available as Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL (links below already do). The full text of every concept in one file is at https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/llms-full.txt.

## Engine

- [Verify & Solve Any UI Before It Ships](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/ui-math.md): Bi-directional neuro-symbolic engine combining <15ms forward mathematical oracles (calc) with 6-pass Playwright DOM/SVG verification across 53 deterministic laws.

## Color & Contrast

- [Make Text Readable on Any Surface or Gradient](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/text-contrast.md): Make every message easy to read, on light or dark backgrounds.
- [Prevent Neon Glare & Oversaturated Accent Floods](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/surface-chroma.md): Cap oversaturated card chroma and enforce high-chroma viewport territorial budgets using OKLCH perceptual color space and Helmholtz-Kohlrausch luminance surge limits.
- [Keep Dark-Mode Badges & Chips From Disappearing](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/pill-saliency.md): Enforce optical boundary distinctness and hairline border enclosures on dark status pills, tags, chips, and circular avatars so they remain distinctly visible.

## Responsive Layout

- [Eliminate Flat 3-Card Rows & Template Layouts](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/zipf-hierarchy.md): Visual hierarchy verification ensuring top-level regions command focal dominance using the Zipf-Lorenz area dominance ratio.
- [Build Balanced Bento Grids Without Orphan Gaps](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/bento-grid.md): Enforcing primary anchor cell prominence (>= 35% area) and complete modulo-zero column span closure in responsive bento grid layouts.
- [Stop Cards From Crushing on Split-Pane & Mobile](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/responsive-layout.md): Preserve minimum component territorial card width (>= 145px) and eliminate horizontal viewport scrolling across desktop (1280px), split-pane (680px), and mobile (390px).
- [Prevent Overlapping Text & Broken Ellipsis Truncation](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/ink-disjointness.md): Preventing direct text ink collisions, glyph overlap, uncontained text bleeding, and broken inline ellipsis truncation across responsive containers.
- [Stress-Test Layouts Against Worst-Case Data](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/stress-testing.md): Inject adversarial 255-character strings, unbroken CJK text, and large numbers to expose flex squishing, avatar distortion, and ink clipping before shipping.
- [Position Modals & Wizards at the Optical Center](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/flow-center.md): Golden-ratio vertical positioning for modal dialogs and linear flow wizards within the 35%–56% optical window (target 45% of viewport height).
- [Build Honest Charts That Never Distort Data](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/data-viz.md): Ensure charts and data visualizations convey truthful proportions with zero-anchored baselines, Stevens-law bubble radiuses, monotonic spline interpolation, and collision-free SVG labels.

## Information Density

- [Stop Cramming Too Many Metrics Into One Card](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/card-density.md): Cognitive density limits for dashboard summary cards based on pre-attentive the 4-item glance limit (K_max in [3, 9]) and area-weighted atom budgeting.
- [Strip Repetitive Badges, Redundant Captions & Scar-Tissue Copy](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/heading-tautology.md): Eliminating decorative badge spam, tautological headings, and defensive helper-text slop using Shannon information entropy and Rachel's 4-rung subtractive copy ladder.
- [Cap Top-Level Navigation Before Users Freeze](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/nav-choice.md): Bounding primary navigation links to prevent cognitive choice paralysis using the Hick-Hyman logarithmic decision latency model (n <= 6 items).
- [Chunk Long Forms Into Digestible Steps](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/fieldset-overload.md): Bounding contiguous form inputs per fieldset (<= 5 inputs) to prevent cognitive fatigue, visual overwhelm, and form abandonment.

## Typography

- [Separate Font Sizes So Hierarchy Looks Intentional](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/font-scale.md): Enforcing perceptual font size step ratios (>= 1.12x) and strict 3-family font stack discipline using the clear 12% visual step of Just-Noticeable Difference.
- [Align Table Numbers & Prevent Mobile Table Crush](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/tabular-ergonomics.md): Decimal numeric right-alignment with tabular-nums, zero interior vertical borders, Bouma column clearance, and mobile horizontal containment.
- [Tighten Large Headings & Cap Paragraph Line Width](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/display-tracking.md): Tightening letter spacing on large display headings (<= -0.025em) and bounding prose paragraph measure (<= 36em / ~65ch) for comfortable reading flow.

## Physical Ergonomics

- [Stop Stacking Borders on Drop Shadows & Fix Nested Corners](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/card-boundaries.md): Continuous boundary energy conservation (Eb <= 1.25), concentric inner corner curvature geometry, and Gestalt proximity padding ratios.
- [Size Touch Targets & Stop iOS Input Auto-Zoom](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/target-ergonomics.md): Ensuring touch target acquisition thresholds (>= 36x36px standalone / >= 28x28px toolbar) and preventing destructive mobile viewport auto-zoom with a 16px input font-size floor.
- [Snap Layouts to Clean Vertical Alignment Rails](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/alignment-axes.md): Bound distinct horizontal layout axes using Kolmogorov Information Theory and prevent dynamic title-metadata collisions on responsive headers.
- [Make Mobile Web Apps Feel Installed, Not Embedded](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/mobile-native-physics.md): Eliminate sticky touch hover states, viewport URL-bar clipping, gray tap flashes, and accidental text selection on mobile web interfaces.
- [Keep Animations on the GPU & Choose the Right Easing](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/motion-choreography.md): Enforce physical spring easing curves, strict GPU compositor property isolation (transform and opacity), and a 400ms Doherty response latency ceiling.
- [Morph States & Shared Layouts Without Distortion](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/fluid-continuity.md): Ensure continuous visual flow across container changes, shared element transitions, optical icon morphs, and asymmetric exit reflows without glyph stretching or GPU paint thrashing.
- [Delete Motion on High-Frequency & Keyboard Actions](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/interaction-frequency.md): Eliminate animation fatigue by scaling duration inversely with interaction frequency: instant keyboard shortcuts, warm tooltip handoffs, capped list staggers, and optimistic updates.
- [Make Gestures, Sheets & Popovers Interruptible](https://chama-x.github.io/first-principles-ui-docs/spring-gesture-physics.md): Build physically grounded gesture sheets and popovers with 1:1 pointer tracking, velocity-seeded spring releases, critical damping, and interruptible state machines.
